description: Entries need vertical structure: create modules via set-project-architecture / set-module-details before or when adding entries. Set refs.moduleName to an existing module name from list-modules. Run validate after edits to find entries-without-modules, entry-unlinked, or empty slices. Creates or updates one canonical project fact (entry). Use when you discovered a concrete fact while working. Do not use for module structure—use set-module-details. Do not copy module.description into summary; link via refs.moduleName only. Upsert: pass id to update, or omit id to match by kind+title or create new. Example: kind=http-endpoint, title='POST /orders', summary='Creates order', refs.moduleName='orders', refs.files=['src/OrderController.java'].

id.description: Entry uuid; omit to upsert by kind+title or create new

kind.description: Free-form type: http-endpoint, glossary, entity, flow, script, godot-scene, etc. Builtin slice list-slices shows recommended kinds per sliceId

payload.description: Kind-specific extra fields only, e.g. method/path for APIs, steps for flow

projectId.description: Required. Call list-projects first (query by workspace folder name) and pass the matching projectId. Never omit. default-project is forbidden.

entryIds.description: Related entry ids, e.g. flow steps pointing to other entries

files.description: Workspace-relative file paths where this fact lives

moduleName.description: Module name from list-modules. Required when project has modules. Do not paste module description here—link by name.

summary.description: 1-2 sentences; not a module essay—only this fact

tags.description: Optional labels for get-slice query filtering

title.description: Short unique label for search, e.g. 'POST /orders' or 'Order'

name: set-entry
title: Set Entry
